title: Quant'è? Prezzi ed euro
summary: Asking prices, handling euro and centesimi, and paying at the bar

blocks.title: Quanto costa?
blocks.body: Money in Italian: **l'euro** (plural *gli euro* — it never changes!) and **il centesimo** (cent). To ask a price, there are two questions: **Quanto costa?** for one thing, **Quant'è?** for the whole total. Prices are written with a **comma**, not a period: *3,50 €* is 'tre euro e cinquanta'.
blocks.callout: euro never gets a plural -i: due euro, dieci euro, mai 'euri'.

pairs.note: Same idea, different scope: one thing vs. the whole bill.

blocks.prompt: You've ordered un caffè and a cornetto and want the total. What do you ask?
blocks.explain: **Quant'è?** asks for the whole bill; *quanto costa* is for pricing just one item.

blocks.prompt: Write out 'four euros and fifty cents' the way you'd say it at the register.
blocks.hint: euro stays singular-looking even with a number in front — no plural -i.
blocks.explain: **Quattro euro e cinquanta** — euro never changes form for the plural.

blocks.scene: You and Marco are at the bar; he insists on treating you, then you insist on paying.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.target: Allora, oggi offro io. Due caffè, per favore!
lines.en: So, today it's my treat. Two coffees, please!

lines.speaker: You
lines.en: No no, I'm paying! How much is it?
lines.spotlight: Quant'è? — asking for the total, not the price of one thing.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.target: Dai, fa niente... ma va bene. Sono tre euro in tutto.
lines.en: Come on, it's nothing... but okay. That's three euros total.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Ecco tre euro. Grazie per oggi!
lines.en: Here's three euros. Thanks for today!

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.target: Figurati! La prossima volta offro di nuovo io.
lines.en: Don't mention it! Next time it's my treat again.

questions.q: How much do the two coffees cost in total?
Who ends up paying this time?

blocks.prompt: Write three short lines you'd actually say while paying for coffee: ask the total, state a price, say thanks.
